task.summary: Add a cross-session, auditable Task/Object Resolution Layer in front of every Personal OS task create path.
task.reason: The capability will govern Task, Goal, Plan, Project, Client, Company, Financial Item, and Knowledge intake across future Personal OS entry points.

queries: repository: duplicate canonical semantic relationship dependency parent_task goal idempotency
Personal OS Codex threads: Task lifecycle, Goals & Plans, scheduler, Google Tasks CRUD
local capability registry: semantic task resolution deduplication task graph workflow object resolution

evidence.summary: Existing create path already has title-bigram duplicate detection, but only returns one open same-date candidate and cannot classify update, dependency, related, parent-child, goal-link, or conflict relationships.
Goals & Plans already has update-first semantic scoring and canonical identity preservation that can be generalized instead of replaced.

evidence.source: Supabase migrations and Codex task history
evidence.summary: The current chain already provides Google Tasks as Task source of truth, task_schedule_metadata, task_context_links, durable idempotency, lifecycle audit, Calendar projection, and follow-up parent metadata.
No registered semantic task/object resolution capability was found.

queries: installed skills and plugins for task graph, semantic deduplication, entity resolution, workflow orchestration
configured MCP/app tools for task or goal relationship resolution

evidence.source: Installed Skills and callable tool inventory
evidence.summary: reuse-first and personal-systems govern the workflow; GitHub supports read-only discovery. No installed Skill, plugin, MCP server, or CLI owns Personal OS semantic resolution or its Google Tasks/Supabase persistence boundary.

queries: PostgreSQL pg_trgm similarity and indexed retrieval
Supabase semantic search and hybrid search with pgvector
Google Tasks tasks.insert parent and tasks.list time/status filters

evidence.summary: pg_trgm is a trusted PostgreSQL extension with similarity functions and GiST/GIN index support suitable for low-cost candidate retrieval.
Supabase recommends combining keyword and vector rankings for semantic retrieval; pgvector remains a compatible scale-up path once an embedding lifecycle is justified.
Google Tasks natively accepts a parent task identifier on insert, so parent-child persistence should extend the existing provider rather than introduce a second task store.
Google Tasks can retrieve open, future, and recently completed candidates with due, completion, and updated filters, enabling cross-session resolution from the real task source.

queries: GitHub semantic deduplication entity resolution task graph JavaScript Postgres

evidence.summary: 22,909 stars, 1,306 forks, 14 open issues, pushed 2026-08-20; PostgreSQL-style license. Mature vector retrieval, but embedding generation is an additional lifecycle.
3,250 stars, 570 forks, 141 open issues, pushed 2026-09-04; MIT. Strong agent workflow graphs, but it does not resolve or persist canonical Google Task identities.

4,510 stars, 576 forks, 91 open issues, last pushed 2025-07-29; MIT. Strong trained record linkage, but its Python/training-data model is mismatched to small Chinese natural-language task streams in Deno Edge Functions.

905 stars, 215 forks, 221 open issues, pushed 2026-09-04; MIT. Mature durable execution SDK, but adopting its server/runtime would duplicate the current Supabase scheduler for this resolution problem.

comparison.reason: Compose the current canonical Google Tasks/Supabase path with a normalized relationship engine and PostgreSQL candidate retrieval. This covers V1 without a new service or source of truth, while preserving pgvector as a measured scale-up option.

decision.reason: Extend the existing intake, lifecycle, Goal matching, scheduler, audit, and Google Tasks provider; use pg_trgm only for bounded cross-session candidate retrieval. Domain relationship classification remains dependency-free and explainable in the current Node/Deno core.
